sre-oncall: running clear script on one pod now, will canary.

sre-oncall: creating follow-up ticket PBI-7902 (postmortem + action items). adding runbook update to require kvcache smoke test and a rollback play.

incident-bot: Alert PM-3487 resolved — state=closed after automated alert suppression (no active anomalies for 10m).

jordan: marking thread resolved from oncall side. nice quick mitigation, props to the team :thumbsup:

mei: prepping customer status email draft, will post in #support-updates for review.
